title: The Drone Ban and a Quiet Singles Day
titleZh: 无人机禁令与冷清双十一
description: Steven describes an unusually quiet Singles Day and his decluttering plans instead of shopping, then explains how Beijing's new drone ban is sending him on a weekend trip to Tianjin to ship his DJI Mavic away. He also covers Canadian energy stocks after the US midterms and a lime-and-chocolate pie that supposedly brings good fortune.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Episode overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目，史蒂文聊了聊冷清得出奇的双十一，还有他“断舍离”而不是剁手的打算。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about an unusually quiet Singles' Day, and about his plan to declutter instead of going on a shopping spree.

sentences.zh: 接着是本周最让人头疼的事：北京出台了无人机禁令，他不得不周末跑一趟天津。
sentences.en: Next comes the biggest headache of the week: Beijing introduced a drone ban, so he had to make a weekend trip to Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 最后，他谈到美国中期选举后的加拿大能源股，还有一块据说能带来财运的派。
sentences.en: Finally, he talks about Canadian energy stocks after the US midterm elections, and a pie that supposedly brings good fortune.

sentences.zh: 悄无声息的双十一
sentences.en: A Quiet Singles' Day

sentences.zh: 昨天是双十一，也就是中国的“光棍节”，相当于加拿大人的黑色星期五。
sentences.en: Yesterday was Double Eleven, also known as China's "Singles' Day," the equivalent of Black Friday for Canadians.

sentences.zh: 可史蒂文几乎没什么感觉。
sentences.en: But Steven barely noticed it.

sentences.zh: 他昨天只上了一节课，是雅思班的学生考口语期中考试，同事们也没人提起购物。
sentences.en: He only taught one class yesterday, where his IELTS students took their midterm speaking exam, and none of his coworkers mentioned shopping either.

sentences.zh: 这多少要怪他自己。
sentences.en: That's partly his own fault.

sentences.zh: 他不看电视：家里的“小翼管家”平板什么都要收费，真正的电视又一直显示登录错误。
sentences.en: He doesn't watch TV: the "Xiaoyi Butler" tablet at home charges for everything, and the actual TV keeps showing a login error.

sentences.zh: 可就算走出家门，他也没看到广告：
sentences.en: But even when he left home, he didn't see any ads:

sentences.zh: 楼里正在换电梯，广告牌都撤了
sentences.en: The elevators in his building are being replaced, so the billboards have all been taken down

sentences.zh: 小区大门口什么也没有
sentences.en: There's nothing at the neighborhood's front gate

sentences.zh: 连京东和淘宝的广告都少了
sentences.en: Even the JD and Taobao ads have become fewer

sentences.zh: 他问女朋友要不要买点什么，她反问：“有什么可买的？”
sentences.en: He asked his girlfriend if she wanted to buy anything, and she asked back, "What is there to buy?"

sentences.zh: 六本笔记本，无人认领（暂时）
sentences.en: Six notebooks, unclaimed (for now)

sentences.zh: 他们家正在“清库存”。
sentences.en: His household is "clearing out inventory."

sentences.zh: 史蒂文数了数，家里有六本笔记本，大多是赠品，来自大学、前雇主、以前的健身房，甚至体检中心。
sentences.en: Steven counted them up: there are six notebooks at home, mostly freebies from universities, former employers, old gyms, and even a medical checkup center.

sentences.zh: 他还翻出一本旧的中文笔记本，那时他写的还是拼音，不是汉字。
sentences.en: He also dug out an old Chinese notebook from back when he was still writing in pinyin, not characters.

sentences.zh: 他打算送给雅思学生，不过有个条件。
sentences.en: He plans to give them to his IELTS students, but on one condition.

sentences.zh: 用他的话说：“别再把这东西拿回来给我。”
sentences.en: In his words: "Don't bring these things back to me."

sentences.zh: 大疆 Osmo 的诱惑
sentences.en: The temptation of the DJI Osmo

sentences.zh: 如果非要买点什么，他会选新出的竖屏版大疆 Osmo，因为它能连上他拍 TikTok 用的大疆麦克风。
sentences.en: If he had to buy something, he'd pick the new vertical-screen DJI Osmo, because it can connect to the DJI microphone he uses for filming TikToks.

sentences.zh: 他的 GoPro 配不上这支麦克风，画质也差一些。
sentences.en: His GoPro isn't good enough for this microphone, and its image quality is a bit worse too.

sentences.zh: 不过他最近很少拍旅行视频，所以暂时不急着买。
sentences.en: But he rarely films travel videos these days, so he's in no hurry to buy one for now.

sentences.zh: 北京禁飞，撞上顺丰
sentences.en: Drone ban in Beijing, and a run-in with SF Express

sentences.zh: 说到相机，就引出了无人机的事。
sentences.en: Speaking of cameras, that brings up the drone situation.

sentences.zh: 北京出台了无人机禁令，现在连在市内“拥有”一架都不行。
sentences.en: Beijing has introduced a drone ban, and now you can't even "own" one within the city.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文只说，这是个“相当爆炸性的决定”。
sentences.en: Steven just said it was a "pretty explosive decision."

sentences.zh: 他的大疆 Mavic 2 Pro 在柜子里躺了大约四年。
sentences.en: His DJI Mavic 2 Pro had been sitting in a cabinet for about four years.

sentences.zh: 再加上今年签证出过麻烦，他不想再惹事。
sentences.en: On top of that, he'd had visa trouble this year, so he didn't want to cause any more problems.

sentences.zh: 周一，他和女朋友把无人机打包好，约了顺丰。
sentences.en: On Monday, he and his girlfriend packed up the drone and booked SF Express.

sentences.zh: 为了买更好的保险，快递员必须亲自验货、亲自打包。
sentences.en: To get better insurance, the courier had to inspect and pack the item in person.

sentences.zh: 结果快递员打开盒子，问：“这是无人机吗？”
sentences.en: Then the courier opened the box and asked, "Is this a drone?"

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说是。
sentences.en: Steven said yes.

sentences.zh: 对方说这个不能寄，把盒子放回去就走了。
sentences.en: The courier said it couldn't be shipped, put the box back, and left.

sentences.zh: 谢了，兄弟。
sentences.en: Thanks, bro.

sentences.zh: ⏰ 周日大限
sentences.en: ⏰ The Sunday Deadline

sentences.zh: 最后期限是本周日，也就是11月15日。
sentences.en: The deadline is this Sunday, November 15th.

sentences.zh: 他不觉得警察会上门搜查，但以后带着无人机坐火车或飞机，他估计会惹上麻烦。
sentences.en: He doesn't think the police will come to his door to search, but he figures that in the future, taking the drone on a train or plane will get him into trouble.

sentences.zh: 罚款可能是500到2000元，而签证的事也让他明白：“规矩就是规矩，法律就是法律。”
sentences.en: The fine could be 500 to 2,000 yuan, and the visa episode also made him understand: "Rules are rules, and the law is the law."

sentences.zh: 反正他不想试。
sentences.en: Either way, he doesn't want to try.

sentences.zh: EMS倒是能寄，但只能通过指定的收寄点，还要有公安备案证明，而他没有。
sentences.en: EMS can actually ship it, but only through designated drop-off points, and it requires a police registration certificate, which he doesn't have.

sentences.zh: 这架无人机他确实用过，比如拍过济南的一座教堂。
sentences.en: He really did use this drone, for example to film a church in Jinan.

sentences.zh: 可大约从2022年起，它就成了得不偿失的负担：
sentences.en: But starting around 2022, it became a burden that wasn't worth the trouble:

sentences.zh: 超过249克，几乎到处都要登记
sentences.en: Over 249 grams, it has to be registered almost everywhere

sentences.zh: 过机场安检时，要把每块电池拆出来，分装进六个安检筐
sentences.en: At airport security, every battery has to be taken out and split across six security trays

sentences.zh: 它得用手机当遥控器，要用手机时就很不方便
sentences.en: It has to use a phone as the remote, which is very inconvenient when he needs the phone

sentences.zh: B计划：天津之行
sentences.en: Plan B: A Trip to Tianjin

sentences.zh: 所以这个周末，他和女朋友要去天津，再从那里把无人机寄给她在上海的姐姐。
sentences.en: So this weekend, he and his girlfriend are going to Tianjin, and from there they'll mail the drone to her older sister in Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 问题是，他几乎从不去上海，而且那里周末的价格“贵得离谱”。
sentences.en: The problem is, he almost never goes to Shanghai, and prices there on weekends are "ridiculously expensive."

sentences.zh: 他的建议是：买无人机之前，先问问自己，下一部旅行视频里那“三秒钟的镜头”值不值得。
sentences.en: His advice: before you buy a drone, ask yourself whether those "three seconds of footage" in your next travel video are worth it.

sentences.zh: 他下周会回来汇报。
sentences.en: He'll be back next week to report on how it went.

sentences.zh: 这个周末不更新。
sentences.en: There's no update this weekend.

sentences.zh: 能源股与中期选举
sentences.en: Energy Stocks and the Midterm Elections

sentences.zh: 先看SSAB股票清单：Tamarack Valley（TVE.TO）和Cenovus（CVE）涨了大约4%到5%。
sentences.en: First, the SSAB stock list: Tamarack Valley (TVE.TO) and Cenovus (CVE) rose about 4% to 5%.

sentences.zh: Tamarack在10月底从15左右跌到11，如今反弹到11.78。
sentences.en: At the end of October, Tamarack fell from around 15 to 11, and has now rebounded to 11.78.

sentences.zh: Cenovus今年已经翻了一倍多，从16美元涨到34美元。
sentences.en: Cenovus has more than doubled this year, rising from 16 dollars to 34 dollars.

sentences.zh: 这不是投资建议，钱是你的，后果自负。
sentences.en: This isn't investment advice; it's your money, and you bear the consequences.

sentences.zh: 中期选举后，民主党拿下众议院，主打的是以能源价格为核心的“生活成本”议题。
sentences.en: After the midterms, the Democrats won the House, campaigning mainly on the "cost of living" issue, centered on energy prices.

sentences.zh: 选举前，数据中心推高电费的说法，是不是被人炒作了？
sentences.en: Before the election, was the claim that data centers were driving up electricity bills just hyped up?

sentences.zh: 还是说，能源股本来就该获利回吐了？
sentences.en: Or were energy stocks simply due for some profit-taking?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说：“拿你赚的钱去买个三明治吧。”
sentences.en: Steven says: "Take the money you made and go buy yourself a sandwich."

sentences.zh: 他只是提出疑问，“我猜你也不知道答案”。
sentences.en: He's just raising the question: "I bet you don't know the answer either."

sentences.zh: 吃派来财
sentences.en: Eat Pie, Get Rich

sentences.zh: 最后说说那块派。
sentences.en: Finally, a word about the pie.

sentences.zh: 他从一位独立烘焙师那里买的，她因为租金太贵，已经没有店面了。
sentences.en: He bought it from an independent baker, who no longer has a storefront because the rent got too expensive.

sentences.zh: 九英寸，一半青柠派，一半巧克力派，360元，另加20元配送费。
sentences.en: Nine inches, half key lime and half chocolate, 360 yuan, plus a 20-yuan delivery fee.

sentences.zh: 那块一英寸厚的黑巧克力，对他来说太浓了。
sentences.en: The inch-thick slab of dark chocolate was too rich for him.

sentences.zh: 倒是加拿大风格、口感浓稠的青柠派，吃起来毫不费力。
sentences.en: The thick, Canadian-style lime pie, on the other hand, went down effortlessly.

sentences.zh: 后来她给他发来一句“吃派来财”。
sentences.en: Afterward, she sent him a message: "Eat pie, get rich."

sentences.zh: 他上一次向她下单是2024年10月17日，两个月后他辞了职，接着整整九个月没有工作。
sentences.en: The last time he ordered from her was October 17, 2024; two months later he quit his job, and then went a full nine months without work.

sentences.zh: 所以，请祝他在派和无人机这两件事上都好运吧。
sentences.en: So please wish him luck with both the pie and the drones.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 有时候，最好的购物就是把东西清出去；而有时候，清掉一样东西，竟然得跑一趟天津。
sentences.en: Sometimes the best shopping is clearing things out, and sometimes getting rid of one thing means you actually have to make a trip to Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 吃派来财，但愿这一次真的灵验。
sentences.en: Eat pie, bring in fortune — let's hope it really works this time.

vocab.en: Double 11, Singles Day shopping festival on November 11
to shop impulsively (lit. "chop off one's hands")
splash screen when opening an app
the gain isn't worth the loss
"eat pie, bring wealth" (a pun on a lucky phrase)
